source_claim: AlphaEvolve describes cascades as hypothesis testing where small-scale filters promote sufficiently promising candidates toward larger main-test cases
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve can report inferred or configured stage roles, deterministic threshold and artifact-check promotion policies, opt-in one-sided lower-confidence-bound gates with retained observations, confidence-bound and p-value evidence, sequential stopping diagnostics, configured error-budget fields, and binomial success-rate gates with Wilson lower-bound evidence. It does not claim benchmark-calibrated thresholds, repeated-seed benchmark fixtures, small-filter-to-main-test linkage, empirical false-promotion validation, or empirical false-rejection validation.
